title: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Industry Leading Noise Canceling Headphones, Black — 30 Hour Battery, Multipoint Connection, Speak-to-Chat
bullets: Industry-leading noise cancellation with eight microphones and the Integrated Processor V1 for quieter flights and offices.
Up to 30 hours of battery life with Quick Attention and Speak-to-Chat so you can talk without removing the headset.
Multipoint Bluetooth connects two devices at once — switch from laptop calls to phone music without re-pairing.
Crystal-clear hands-free calling with AI-based noise reduction tuned for windy outdoor environments.
Soft fit leather and lighter weight than WH-1000XM4 for all-day wear without hot spots.
Foldable design with a compact carry case included for travel.
Compatible with the Sony Headphones Connect app for EQ, adaptive sound control, and firmware updates.
description: The WH-1000XM5 is Sony's flagship over-ear noise canceling headphone aimed at frequent travelers and remote workers who need silence without sacrificing audio detail.
Auto NC Optimizer adjusts cancellation when you wear glasses or change altitude on a plane. 360 Reality Audio support widens the soundstage on compatible tracks.
Touch controls on the right ear cup handle playback, volume, and NC/Ambient switching. Multipoint keeps a work laptop and phone connected simultaneously.

aplus.heading: From the manufacturer
paragraphs: Sony has refined the 1000X series across five generations with a focus on noise canceling algorithms and comfort.
Firmware updates via Headphones Connect continue to add features after purchase.

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.title: Flight essential
reviews.body: NC on a transatlantic flight was dramatically better than my XM3s. Speak-to-Chat is surprisingly natural once you enable it in the app.

reviews.author: Nina V.
reviews.title: Comfortable for 8-hour workdays
reviews.body: I wear these on back-to-back Zoom calls. Clamping force is gentler than XM4 and the mic quality gets compliments from coworkers.

reviews.author: Omar H.
reviews.title: Great ANC, average case
reviews.body: Sound and canceling are excellent. The case is bulkier than I hoped for a personal-item bag, but that is a minor nit.

reviews.author: Elena P.
reviews.title: Touch controls too sensitive
reviews.body: I accidentally pause tracks when adjusting the fit. You can remap some gestures in the app which helped.

qa.question: Can I use these wired?
qa.answer: Yes. A 3.5 mm cable is included. ANC can still run while wired if the battery has charge.

qa.question: Do they work with airplane entertainment systems?
qa.answer: Yes with the included cable. Some airlines need a dual-prong adapter which is not included.
